newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 14.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 14.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Jozsef Torgyan, leader of opposition party Smallholders was nmot an informer of the communist secret services, a screening committee said.
- Police is investigating the murder of a young businessman whose car was blown up on Wednesday afternoon.
- Opposition parties MDF and FIDESZ said a meeting on Friday between the Hungarian and Slovak Prime Ministers would be of no use.
- The cause of Wednesday's power failure that interrupted the MTK-Rosenborg soccer match is still unknown.
- Hungarian gypsies also immigrate to Canada, as the Czech gypsies do.
